=Score this article for Brett Moore's podcast "Fasten Your Seatbelt."

Title: {{ $json.data.title || $('Loop Extract').item.json.title }}
Content: {{ ($json.data.content || '').substring(0, 3000) }}
Category: {{ $('Loop Extract').item.json.category }}
Source: {{ $('Loop Extract').item.json.feed_name }}

Score on 5 dimensions (each 0-10):
1. Relevance - How relevant to Brett's interests (geopolitics, science, tech, economics, quirky)
2. Novelty - Is this new/breaking or a rehash?
3. Cross-Domain - Could this connect to stories in other domains?
4. Storytelling - Is there a compelling narrative arc?
5. Controversy - Would this spark discussion/debate?

Also provide:
- composite_score: weighted average (relevance 0.25, novelty 0.20, cross-domain 0.15, storytelling 0.20, controversy 0.20)
- score_reason: 1-2 sentences explaining the score
- score_category: primary category

Return as JSON object with keys: relevance_score, novelty_score, cross_domain_score, storytelling_score, controversy_score, composite_score, score_reason, score_category
